task: Read the student scores in both midterm1 and midterm2 from score.xlsx. Identify students whose scores increased by 20 points or more from midterm1 to midterm2. Create a new file improved_students.xlsx listing only these students with their scores. Then, summarize the number of improved students and note the improvement criteria in a summary report called improvement_summary.docx.
query_sentence: Create a file with students who had significant improvement and summarize the results in a report.

ground_truth_memory.fact: Only include students who improved by 20 points or more.
ground_truth_memory.action_item: Filter and list only the qualifying students and their scores in improved_students.xlsx

ground_truth_memory.fact: Summarize the number of improved students and the improvement rule in a Word report.
ground_truth_memory.action_item: The report filename should be improvement_summary.docx and mention the improvement criteria (at least 20 points increase) and the count of such students.
